hooks.name: SlopSeal: Verify dependency security before installation
hooks.description: Checks each package install command before it runs. For pinned pip or npm packages (name==x.y.z, name@x.y.z), SlopSeal runs its verification checks on every package. If every package is ALLOW, the command runs (exit 0). If any package is BLOCK, QUARANTINE, RATE_LIMITED, or ERROR, the command is stopped (exit 2) and the output names the package, the check that stopped it, and the next step. An install that SlopSeal cannot verify, such as an unpinned or ranged version, a URL or local path, a requirements file, or another package manager, is also stopped (exit 2) with the form that must change. A command that installs nothing is not affected. If SlopSeal cannot run, the command is stopped (exit 2). Each verified package counts against the install rate limit. Installs the user runs go through the SlopSeal PATH shim, which verifies each package.

action.command: sh -c '"$1" -m slopseal.hooks.on_install; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ $rc -ne 2 ]; then echo "SlopSeal: Unable to verify package. Installation is not permitted. SlopSeal is not installed for \"$1\". Install it into that Python with: \"$1\" -m pip install git+https://github.com/mazi3012/SlopSeal.git" >&2; exit 2; else exit $rc; fi' sh python3
